name: The Kin-Tree
description: A burned stump with golden new growth through which the ancestors speak and to which kin bind themselves by blood.

timeline.summary: At the Kin-Tree Felothar explains why the ancestors matter and how Anafenza showed Dromoka's claim to be a lie.
timeline.quote: Anafenza proved that to be a lie when she discovered and bonded with one.

timeline.summary: Vasi explains that she offered her blood to the Kin-Tree and was told where to find her ward-sister Bara.
timeline.quote: "Looking for Bara, my ward-sister," Vasi says.

relations.note: Anafenza discovered and bonded with a Kin-Tree, at the cost of her life.
relations.quote: The discovery cost Anafenza her life, but the seeds of rebellion had already been planted.
